Introduced rectangular timber yoke, two crown attachment stems, rounded shoulder, flaring body/rim and repair gap descending from partway down body and bending toward lower viewer-right. Gap opens through the lower rim and has one rounded upper termination, not a decorative floating line or invented round hardware glyph. Fine later fissure, inscriptions, hardware details, installation supports, background and visible lower clapper are omitted, not claimed hidden. Front conversion and timber/crown details are illustrative, not proof old wood alone carries the current installation load. External accessible subject/projection/component key required. Nominal dimensions are not architectural survey, crack calibration or current official fabrication geometry. Physical/learner/device fit pending.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic line samples, global3.1mm centre guard; not Braille or semantic point glyphs.
